title: Budget Pacing: Are You Spending Too Fast This Month?
description: Read a budget bar with a today marker: what 60% spent means on day 10 vs day 25, planned early bills, and when to slow down. With a worked example.
intent: how to tell if I'm overspending this month / budget pacing
angle: Fraction spent vs fraction of period elapsed; early rent skews it; daily allowance = remaining / days left incl. today (Pro in app, free in the calculator). Link tools/daily-budget.html.

title: How to Track Your Expenses in the UAE on iPhone
description: A practical UAE setup: AED as main currency, payday on the 25th or 28th, bank SMS alerts in English and Arabic, cash, salary and card bills.
intent: track expenses UAE / best expense tracker app UAE / budget app Dubai
angle: Local reality: banks SMS every transaction, salary near month end, cash taxis, card bills via SMS. No claims about specific banks' compatibility; test with the setup screen check.

title: Track UPI and Bank SMS Expenses on iPhone (India)
description: Turn Indian bank and UPI debit SMS alerts into expenses on iPhone with a Shortcuts automation. Lakh amounts, Rs/INR, A/c masks and what is skipped.
intent: UPI expense tracker iPhone / track bank SMS expenses India iPhone
angle: Indian alert shapes (debited from A/c XX1234, UPI Ref, Avl Bal, lakh grouping 1,15,000, Rs. prefix). Bench evidence is mostly Indian alerts; still say 'supported alerts only'.

title: Track Travel Expenses in Multiple Currencies on iPhone
description: Log trip spending in local currency with the rate your card actually charged, keep a cash account per trip and see the total at home. Step by step.
intent: travel expense tracker multiple currencies iPhone
angle: Card rate vs market rate, foreign fees as expenses, cash per trip, foreign SMS alerts parked until a rate is given. No live rates in the app.

title: Set Up a 50/30/20 Budget on iPhone
description: Split take-home pay into needs, wants and savings, map your categories to each bucket and track it payday to payday. A worked example with real numbers.
intent: 50/30/20 budget app / how to do 50 30 20 budget
angle: Method first (spreadsheet), then categories + category budgets + savings transfers in the app. Not financial advice.

intent: expense tracker widget iPhone / log expense lock screen
angle: Exact iOS steps to add widgets/controls (iOS 17 widgets, iOS 18 controls). Siri phrases from the app's AppShortcuts.

intent: budget app without bank connection / no bank login expense tracker
angle: Fair trade-offs, link compare/best-expense-trackers.html. No claims about competitors' security.

angle: Uses Stats overview (vs same point, category changes, days without spending), Monthly view, CSV export.

angle: Receipt field in the entry sheet (free). Check whether receipts are included in JSON backup before claiming.

description: Move years of expenses into TrackExpenses from a spreadsheet: preparing columns, ambiguous dates, decimal commas, duplicates and undoing an import.
angle: Pro feature. Never claim Money Manager import compatibility until a real export is tested (CLAUDE.md).
